children: HDFC Bank shares edged up marginally on Tuesday, trading at ₹688.70 on the NSE by 10.10 am, a gain of 0.09 per cent over Monday’s close of ₹688.05. Buy orders narrowly led at 50.76 per cent against 49.24 per cent sell orders, with traded volume at 65.10 lakh shares worth ₹447.83 crore a calmer session compared to Monday’s heavier selling.

The mild recovery coincides with a formal regulatory disclosure filed by the bank with BSE and NSE on Tuesday morning. The filing confirmed that Sashidhar Jagdishan vacated the office of MD & CEO at close of business on October 26, 2026, upon completion of his tenure. Anup Bagchi assumed charge as Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer effective October 27, 2026.

title: Why are HDFC Bank shares steady as Bagchi officially takes charge as MD & CEO
